reviews.text: This game is awesome, and you should try it. The movement abilities are well-designed, and very satisfying to perform to complete the levels. You won't have all the movement abilities at the start, but once you go unlocking them, I can't emphasize enough how nice the gameplay feels. You are going to be surprised in that regard. Like other indie games, CYBERMATRIX seems to also be designed with speedruners in mind, and nothing shows that better than the current final level / boss, which is a good example of giving a challenge to the player that requires them to use all the tools they were given. I'm looking forward to seeing what the future levels will look like, and it seems there will also be a level editor some time in the future. But even if the game were to stay unchanged forever, my review would stay the same, it's a really enjoyable experience for a very cheap price.
